title: Starting with the AWS Basics
dek: There is a lot to know about AWS
author: Daniel Mansfield

items: It runs Linux or Windows virtual servers (instances) in the cloud, managed remotely through a browser, CLI or API.
It is IaaS, and other AWS services use it underneath for processing, database hosting and serverless computing.
You choose the OS, storage, number of vCPUs and CPU type (Intel, AMD or Graviton, the AWS-designed processor).
Pricing: reserve instances for a set period, or pay as you go.
Dedicated physical server: one used only by your organization. You can run it with or without a hypervisor, run your own virtualization, and control instance placement.
Elastic means you can resize or customize it at any time. It can also scale automatically, adding or removing instances based on traffic.
The “C2” in EC2 comes from the two Cs in “Compute Cloud.”
